queries.query: SELECT TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.FNAME, u.MNAME, u.LNAME)) AS user_name FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = :userId

SELECT s.id AS subject_id, s.name AS subject_name, qt.topic_code AS topic_code, ${courseCodeExpr} AS course_code, ${sylCodeExpr} AS syl_code, ${unitCodeExpr} AS unit_code, ${modCodeExpr} AS mod_code, AVG( CASE WHEN qt.pass_percentage > 0 THEN qt.pass_percentage ELSE :defaultPass END ) AS required_pass_percentage FROM user_syllabus us JOIN syllabus_subject ss ON ss.id = us.syl_sub_id JOIN subject s ON s.id = ss.sub_id JOIN questionnaire_template qt ON qt.syl_sub_id = ss.id WHERE us.user_id = :userId AND us.enrolled = true AND qt.topic_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(qt.topic_code) <> ''

SELECT s.id AS subject_id, s.name AS subject_name, qt.topic_code AS topic_code, ${courseCodeExpr} AS course_code, ${sylCodeExpr} AS syl_code, ${unitCodeExpr} AS unit_code, ${modCodeExpr} AS mod_code, COUNT(DISTINCT qp.id) AS attempts_count, AVG( CASE WHEN ps.max_score_sum > 0 THEN (ps.score_sum * 100.0 / ps.max_score_sum) ELSE 0 END ) AS average_score_percentage, MAX( CASE WHEN ps.max_score_sum > 0 THEN (ps.score_sum * 100.0 / ps.max_score_sum) ELSE 0 END ) AS highest_score_percentage, MAX(qp.create_date) AS last_submitted_date FROM question_paper qp JOIN questionnaire q ON q.id = qp.questionnaire_id JOIN questionnaire_template qt ON qt.id = q.template_id JOIN syllabus_subject ss ON ss.id = qt.syl_sub_id JOIN subject s ON s.id = ss.sub_id JOIN ( SELECT qpa.paper_id, SUM(qpa.score) AS score_sum, SUM(qpa.max_score) AS max_score_sum FROM question_paper_answer qpa GROUP BY qpa.paper_id ) ps ON ps.paper_id = qp.id WHERE qp.user_id = :userId AND qt.topic_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(qt.topic_code) <> ''

SELECT s.id AS subject_id, qt.topic_code AS topic_code, SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(tqc.topic_questions_count, 0), NULLIF(qc.questions_count, 0), qa.questions_count_from_answers, ${templateQuestionCountExpr}, 0)) AS questions_count, SUM(COALESCE(ac.attended_questions_count, 0)) AS attended_questions_count FROM user_syllabus us JOIN syllabus_subject ss ON ss.id = us.syl_sub_id JOIN subject s ON s.id = ss.sub_id JOIN questionnaire_template qt ON qt.syl_sub_id = ss.id ${topicQuestionCountJoin} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.template_id, COUNT(DISTINCT qq.qstn_id) AS questions_count FROM questionnaire q JOIN questionnaire_question qq ON qq.qstnre_id = q.id GROUP BY q.template_id ) qc ON qc.template_id = qt.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.template_id, COUNT(DISTINCT qpa.question_id) AS questions_count_from_answers FROM question_paper qp JOIN questionnaire q ON q.id = qp.questionnaire_id JOIN question_paper_answer qpa ON qpa.paper_id = qp.id GROUP BY q.template_id ) qa ON qa.template_id = qt.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.template_id, COUNT(DISTINCT qpa.question_id) AS attended_questions_count FROM question_paper qp JOIN questionnaire q ON q.id = qp.questionnaire_id JOIN question_paper_answer qpa ON qpa.paper_id = qp.id WHERE qp.user_id = :userId GROUP BY q.template_id ) ac ON ac.template_id = qt.id WHERE us.user_id = :userId AND us.enrolled = true AND qt.topic_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(qt.topic_code) <> ''

SELECT s.id AS subject_id, qt.topic_code AS topic_code, qp.id AS paper_id, qp.create_date AS created_at, CASE WHEN SUM(qpa.max_score) > 0 THEN (SUM(qpa.score) * 100.0 / SUM(qpa.max_score)) ELSE 0 END AS attempt_percentage FROM question_paper qp JOIN questionnaire q ON q.id = qp.questionnaire_id JOIN questionnaire_template qt ON qt.id = q.template_id JOIN syllabus_subject ss ON ss.id = qt.syl_sub_id JOIN subject s ON s.id = ss.sub_id JOIN question_paper_answer qpa ON qpa.paper_id = qp.id WHERE qp.user_id = :userId AND qt.topic_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(qt.topic_code) <> ''

SELECT s.id AS subject_id, qt.topic_code AS topic_code, SUM(COALESCE(ws.weighted_correct_sum, 0)) AS weighted_correct_sum, SUM(COALESCE(ws.weighted_attempt_sum, 0)) AS weighted_attempt_sum, SUM(COALESCE(ws.fast_incorrect_count, 0)) AS fast_incorrect_count, SUM(COALESCE(ws.total_answer_attempts, 0)) AS total_answer_attempts, SUM(COALESCE(ws.total_time_taken_ms, 0)) AS total_time_taken_ms, SUM(COALESCE(rs.reattempt_count, 0)) AS reattempt_count, SUM(COALESCE(rs.correct_reattempt_count, 0)) AS correct_reattempt_count FROM user_syllabus us JOIN syllabus_subject ss ON ss.id = us.syl_sub_id JOIN subject s ON s.id = ss.sub_id JOIN questionnaire_template qt ON qt.syl_sub_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.template_id, SUM(CASE WHEN qpa.score > 0 THEN ${difficultyWeightExpr} ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_correct_sum, SUM(${difficultyWeightExpr}) AS weighted_attempt_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN qpa.score <= 0 AND ${timeTakenExpr} > 0 AND ${timeTakenExpr} <= :fastIncorrectThresholdMs THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fast_incorrect_count, COUNT(*) AS total_answer_attempts, SUM(COALESCE(${timeTakenExpr}, 0)) AS total_time_taken_ms FROM question_paper qp JOIN questionnaire q ON q.id = qp.questionnaire_id JOIN question_paper_answer qpa ON qpa.paper_id = qp.id LEFT JOIN question qu ON qu.id = qpa.question_id WHERE qp.user_id = :userId GROUP BY q.template_id ) ws ON ws.template_id = qt.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rq.template_id, SUM(CASE WHEN rq.attempts_count > 1 THEN rq.attempts_count - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reattempt_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rq.correct_count > 1 THEN rq.correct_count - 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_reattempt_count FROM ( SELECT q.template_id, qpa.question_id, COUNT(*) AS attempts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN qpa.score > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_count FROM question_paper qp JOIN questionnaire q ON q.id = qp.questionnaire_id JOIN question_paper_answer qpa ON qpa.paper_id = qp.id WHERE qp.user_id = :userId GROUP BY q.template_id, qpa.question_id ) rq GROUP BY rq.template_id ) rs ON rs.template_id = qt.id WHERE us.user_id = :userId AND us.enrolled = true AND qt.topic_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(qt.topic_code) <> ''
